description: Enable or disable the widget, or point its invite channel. An enabled widget shows the server's name, who is online, and its voice channels to anyone on the web, and with an invite channel it lets anyone join. So turning it on, or pointing it at an invite channel while it is on, needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. Turning it off or clearing the channel happens at once.

channel.description: Invite channel name or ID, or none to clear.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: update_server_widget
title: Update server widget
